'''moogle25 BHBM but only if he wants to come!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[moogle25]]
* '''Published:''' 29 August 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 BHBM moogle25 DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits The Emperor (V) (Virtual Set 6), Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6), General Veers (V) (Virtual Set 4), Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4), Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4), Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6), Breached Defenses (V) (Virtual Set 4), Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 4), Levitation Attack (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

fun BHBM deck based on endor...it can turn luke but doesn't have to to win...

The published list has 66 cards.

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Allegations Of Corruption (Dark)|Ref3-D-allegationsofcorruption.gif|label=Allegations Of Corruption}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Battle Order (Dark)|Ref3-D-battleorder.gif|label=Battle Order}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Come Here You Big Coward (Dark)|Ref3-D-comehereyoubigcoward.gif|label=Come Here You Big Coward}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Resistance (Dark)|Ref3-D-resistance.gif|label=Resistance}}

Four Defensive Shields are named under Fear Is My Ally and dested outside the deck: Allegations Of Corruption, Battle Order, Come Here You Big Coward, Resistance.

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): General Veers (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard Scout 1 (V), Breached Defenses (V) (Virtual Set 4); Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5); The Emperor (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Levitation Attack (V) (Virtual Set 6); Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 7).
* Qty 66 as published: 'Bindersx6' is listed under Fear Is My Ally with the shields (the strategy says the Binders sit 'under FIMA' and are pulled with Levitation Attack (V)); the section headers add to 60 without them. Drop them if they start outside the deck.
* Security Precautions (V) and the printed Security Precautions are both in the deck, as the strategy explains.
* Original-era printing corrected: Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 7) -> Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 4) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

ok, before you activate use mob points combo to pull carida into hand..

first turn, activate at least 3 force...use IAO combo to pull a docking bay and deploy it...i usually pull the endor one.

use 2 force and Locationx3 (V) to deploy the back door from reserve, while making this search also make sure that both security precautions(V and non-V) are in reserve. also deploy carida...now, depending on what deck LS is playing, i ditch mob points combo to pull security precautions(only if the right one was in reserve deck)...if he is playing HB then pull non-v but otherwise pull the virtual one and put it down on the back door...

if your opponent gave you 2 force then pull emperor and put him down at the back door, if you deploy palpy then grab a force lightening too but if you did emperor (V) then don't worry about it...if you didn't get enough to deploy the emperor then draw the last one(or two) into hand

second turn...activate at least 8(9 if you got out emperor) force...ok pull your other docking bay with IAO combo, and then use 2 force to deploy another battleground site from reserve....now you are pretty much setup...

all thats left to do is just boost your ground up and go after opponents sites...you should have enough space to hold carida and you can satisfy battle plan...this deck isn't really meant to flip but if you do then get everyone to the DS2 throne room quick :) now i'll explains some of my card choices

the main reason i have both of versions of security precautions is because HB is very popular around here and because i need the extra activation...

ok now i'll explain the reason i have all the binders under FIMA. i can use leviation attack(V) to pull them and then deploy them on characters. once i get out all 6 i can then use weapon of an ungrateful son(lost) to place all of them into my used pile...boom...6 extra destiny 6 cards in my reserve and i can start tracking them all...my friend showed me this tech...its pretty bomb...

i have the walkers in there to either boost my ground on endor or i can go after people on yavin or hoth or any other exterior sites...

i have a maul with stick and p-59 in here as a mini hit sqaud...i also have the tat maul in here to put on his ship and go around probing for HB and doing some nice damage with security precautions...

limited resources is bomb and so is dark jedi presence if people decide to come after emperor :)

also i'd have more emperors in here but as i don't own anymore i can't put them in here...

help me make this better by reviewing it...thanx...
